==Trivia==
*{{PAGENAME}} has a unique attack type where he shoots traps to the ground, it takes some time to get ready, any enemy that steps on the trap gets damaged, so it is recommended to put {{PAGENAME}} behind the frontlines where the traps will be successful.
* He and his [[Captain (God)|evolved form]] were the first units that do not deal Physical or Magic damage. His case is ''purely'' true damage.
